text:
Predicates:
TransportMultiple(x) ::: x can transport multiple passengers.
OneSeater(x) ::: x is a one-seater.
TeslaModel3(x) ::: x is a Tesla Model 3.
SingleSeatElectric(x) ::: x is a single-seat electric car.
SoloEV(x) ::: x is a Solo EV car.
Premises:
∀x (TransportMultiple(x) → ¬OneSeater(x)) ::: If something can transport multiple passengers, then it is not a one-seater.
∀x (TeslaModel3(x) → TransportMultiple(x)) ::: All Tesla Model 3 can transport multiple passengers.
∀x (SingleSeatElectric(x) → OneSeater(x)) ::: All single-seat electric cars are one-seaters.
∀x (SoloEV(x) → SingleSeatElectric(x)) ::: All Solo EV cars are single-seat electric cars.
¬TeslaModel3(johnsCar) → ¬(TeslaModel3(johnsCar) ∨ SingleSeatElectric(johnsCar)) ::: If John's car is not a Tesla Model 3, then John's car is not a Tesla Model 3 or a single-seat electric car.
Conclusion:
TeslaModel3(johnsCar) ::: John's car is a Tesla Model 3.
